breakdown.description: The 2D line traction on the top edge is reinterpreted as a 3D surface pressure
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to fix the inconsistency. It repeated the incorrect instruction from the original prompt, stating: "Interpret the top-edge load as a 3D pressure of 2000 Pa acting on the top face." The ground truth clarifies that this should be interpreted as a "2D line traction per unit out-of-plane thickness".
